The official Go release tag resolves to the pinned commit and the independently retrieved bytes match the registered digest.

challenge.method: Compare a break that exits this range loop to normal completion of its body and to a break targeting a nested construct. Check whether the cited paragraph specifies a consequence for calling yield again.
challenge.results: The paragraph gives true after an ordinary completed iteration and false if the body exits the loop. A break targeting a nested construct can leave the range loop running and does not meet the condition. The stated prohibition supplies no diagnostic or panic mechanism for a later violation.

limitations: The break must terminate this range loop. The claim covers the protocol and leaves the response to a prohibited later call unspecified.
